verdict.rationale: Buzz ships a Desktop-bundled 'managed agent' with a first-party skill that lets users conversationally delegate tasks (create agents, send messages, manage channels/workflows/repos) directly inside the product, backed by buzz-acp/buzz-agent runtimes and an owner-review governance gate. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the assistant's real-world reliability and no non-vendor benchmark results beyond Block's own harbor tasks.
